title.narrative: AHRF - HR in Syria - Enhancing nascent actors - 1
AHRF - MR i Syrien - Stärka nya aktörer

description.narrative: Projektet kommer att fokusera på nya lokala aktörer (civil samhälles organisationer samt sk Lokala coordinating committees) i Syrien och bygga deras kapacitet om mänskliga rättigheter och projekt planering. Fokus ligger på att ge dem kunskaper om instrument för mänskliga rättigheter och institutionella strukturer, samt att fostra en kultur av mänskliga rättigheter hos nya och framtida institutioner som ska säkra rättigheter. Projektet kommer att pågå under 18 månader till en kostnad av 4 850 000 kronor

This project will focus on target local emerging actors to provide them with training on Human Rights and project planning. The focus is to provide them with knowledge in human rights instruments and institutional structures, as well as fostering long-term commitments to human rights among emerging duty bearers. The project grant is for 18 months for 4 850 000. The aim of the strategy for the Middle East and North Africa are: stronger democracy and greater respect for human rights; and sustainable development that improves conditions for peace, stability and freedom in the region. The AHRF project aims at contributing to the enhancement of democratic local governance structures as well as promoting a civil society by bringing in the notion of Human Right based programming in Syria. Thus the project is expected to contribute to the strategy and sector objectives. By the end of the project, the Fund expects that the targeted actors in Syria will have a better capacity to plan, organize, and implement human rights projects. In addition, the project will strengthen the targeted actors’ knowledge of human rights instruments and project implementation as well as providing the targeted Local Citizens’ Committees and other duty bearers with a better understanding of how to embed human rights in their work.

To strenghten emerging actors in Syria by providing them with solid footing in human rights instruments and institutional structures, as well as fostering long-term commitments to human rights among emerging duty bearers.
